annotation.interpretation_a: The Additional section data is proactively cached upon receiving the SVCB response, even before any follow-up queries are initiated.
annotation.interpretation_b: The Additional section data is cached *after* a follow-up query is made, but the caching is recommended to happen quickly to optimize performance.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'before performing any followup queries' is open to interpretation. It could mean before initiating the queries, or before completing them. This affects when the cache is populated and thus impacts performance.
annotation.missing_information: The timing of the cache placement relative to the follow-up queries is not clearly defined. Does 'before performing any followup queries' mean immediately upon receipt of the SVCB response, or before the *completion* of any follow-up queries?
